tabs.$description: Tokens for Tabs: switch between panels of related content in place. Measured from AcmeCo's Language and Region dialog (live site, 2026-10-10) and the audit's F18 Tab set (34 instances, 6 experiences). Decision 36.

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 24px between tabs (the dialog's tabs at 25 and 234px, the first 185px wide).

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: 400 for the current tab and 300 for the others; became 400 for both (decision 4: two weights), so the underline and colour mark the current tab.

padding-y.$description: OBSERVED: 11px above and below the label; became 8px, giving 43px tabs, above the 24px target minimum.

panel-gap.$description: OBSERVED: 18px from the tab line to the options; became 16px.

default.$description: OBSERVED: #4f5254 at weight 300 for the other tabs; became the secondary grey #63666a (5.77:1), so the current tab in ink stands out.

selected.$description: OBSERVED: black (#000) for the current tab; became ink.

color.$description: OBSERVED, LEGACY-NAMED: a 2px #123a7a (--legacy-color-brand) line under the current tab; 10.98:1 on white, so it marks the tab without relying on the text colour.
OBSERVED: a 1px #ddd line under the tabs (2px #e5e5e5 in some F18 sets); became the one border grey. Decorative.
PROPOSED: the system's focus ring (AcmeCo's tabs can't take focus).
